# NuvLoc

Agent-driven localization CLI for sibling `.resx` hosts (MAUI, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno). Command `nuvloc`. Package `NuvyntraLabs.NuvLoc.Cli`.

- GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvLoc
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/NuvyntraLabs.NuvLoc.Cli
- Version: 1.1.2
- Install: `dotnet tool install -g NuvyntraLabs.NuvLoc.Cli --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json`
- Local: `dotnet pack … -o artifacts` then `dotnet tool install -g NuvyntraLabs.NuvLoc.Cli --add-source ./artifacts --configfile ./nuget.config --ignore-failed-sources --version 1.1.2`
- Uninstall: `dotnet tool uninstall -g NuvyntraLabs.NuvLoc.Cli`
- Config: `i18n.json` with `platform` (`maui`, `wpf`, `winui`, `avalonia`, `uno`), `source`, `languages` (BCP-47). Tested: `es`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `nl`, `ja`, `ko`, `zh-Hans`, `pt-BR`, `ar`, `hi`, `ru`. Other BCP-47 codes work; non-BCP-47 skips the culture file and prints the reason. Issues: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvLoc/issues
- Wire: `nuvloc init --configfile i18n.json --agent cursor`
- Agent: `/nuvloc.status` and `/nuvloc.translate`
- CI: `nuvloc check`
- No API keys. The coding agent translates. NuvLoc writes sibling culture `.resx` files only; UI binding is the host’s choice. WinUI / Uno PRI `.resw` folders are out of scope.
- NuvLoc does not give a 100% guarantee on translated text. Review with a native speaker of each target language before ship.
